name: hketa-apk
description: HKETA Hong Kong public transport ETA — signed release Android APK (Cordova + TypeScript + Kotlin), Android 8–17

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx --yes serve www
scripts.android:add: cordova platform add android@15.1.0 && cordova plugin add ./native-plugin/hketa-native
scripts.android:build: npm run build && cordova build android --release --buildConfig=build.json
